recaps.text: England beat New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham, their biggest win over the All Blacks, with tries from Slade, van Poortvliet, Earl, Chessum and Atkinson; Ireland beat South Africa 20-17.
Kansas City Current beat Washington Spirit 2-1 at Audi Field to win their first NWSL title, with Debinha scoring in stoppage time.
Michael van Gerwen beat Tom Sykes 16-11 after both hit nine-darters, and Gian van Veen beat Nathan Aspinall 16-14, so the semi-finals are Doets v Price and van Gerwen v van Veen.

lookAhead: Tuesday brings Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund at 3:00 PM and the second England T20I in Australia at 3:15 AM, then England v New Zealand again in the Nations Championship on Saturday at 11:40 AM.
